DuttaLahiri.scope: Lemma3.3/Theorem3.4 statements and proofs;Theorem2.17 statement only
DuttaLahiri.summary: For an affine one-dimensional algebra over an algebraically closed field, characteristic zero or seminormal reduced ring, residual coordinates with at least three variables are one-stable. Denominator clearing supplies an exponential map after localization. Applied here to C[p] and four variables; it does not establish unstabilized coordinate status. Theorem2.17 states the locally symmetric finitely presented algebra result and attributes it to BCW/Suslin; that quotation is secondary evidence for BCW, not inspection of its original.

Brion.summary: On reduced group schemes, isomorphism of action and projection pullbacks is the linearization criterion. The equivariant Picard exact sequence describes ambiguity and obstruction. For normal schemes, a power governed by the stable exponent of the group Picard group linearizes. For the additive group the character ambiguity disappears; the paper also shows normality cannot simply be dropped. These are selected old-scope interfaces, not a review of every cited proof.
